source: User-supplied resources/lyrics-spelling/返來恁身邊-蕭煌奇

blocks.text: 離開故鄉有歸十年
blocks.spelling: lī-khui kòo-hiong ū kui tsa̍p nî

blocks.text: 阮定定想到彼段難忘的過去
blocks.spelling: gún tiānn-tiānn siūnn-tio̍h hit tuānn lân-bông ê kuè-khì

blocks.text: 置夢中攏會甲恁來見面
blocks.spelling: tì bāng-tiong lóng ē kā lí lâi kìnn-bīn

blocks.text: 會記得彼年的夏天　我欲去真遠的冬天
blocks.spelling: ē-kì-tit hit nî ê hā-thinn guá beh khì tsin hn̄g ê tang-thinn

blocks.text: 恁的溫情　伴阮飛過千里
blocks.spelling: lín ê un-tsîng phuānn gún pue-kuè tshian-lí

blocks.text: 為著理想來到台北市　一個人過著簡單的日子
blocks.spelling: uī-tio̍h lí-sióng lâi kàu Tāi-pak-tshī tsi̍t ê lâng kuè-tio̍h kán-tan ê li̍t-tsí

blocks.text: 阮心內有時　會感覺真稀微
blocks.spelling: gún sim-lāi ū-sî ē kám-kak tsin hi-bî

blocks.text: 打工恁打電話給我　攏會問我今嘛甘有吃飽
blocks.spelling: phah-kang lí phah tiān-uē hōo lóng mn̄g guá tsit-má kam-ū tsia̍h-pá

blocks.text: 請恁放心　我會照顧我自己
blocks.spelling: tshiánn lín hòng-sim guá ē tsiàu-kòo guá ka-kī

blocks.text: 親愛的爸爸媽媽　只要恁平安快樂過日子
blocks.spelling: tshin-ài ē pā-pā-má-má tsí-iàu lí pîng-an khuài-lo̍k kuè li̍t-tsí

blocks.text: 不需要擱計較什麼　再大的風雨攏會過去
blocks.spelling: bô-su-iàu koh kè-kàu siánn-mih tsài tuā ê hong-hōo lóng ē kuè-khì

blocks.text: 返來恁身邊看你　有一日我一定會出頭天
blocks.spelling: tńg-lâi lín sin-pinn khuànn lí ū tsi̍t-li̍t guá it-tīng ē tshut-thâu-thinn

blocks.text: 倒返去甲恁來團圓　陪伴置恁身邊　袂來甲恁分開
blocks.spelling: tó tńg-khì kā lí lâi thuân-înn puê-phuānn tì lí sin-pinn buē lâi kā lín hun-khui

blocks.text: 為著理想來到台北市　阮嘛慢慢會通慣習
blocks.spelling: uī-tio̍h lí-sióng lâi kàu Tāi-pak-tshī gún mā bān-bān ē-tàng kuàn si̍p

blocks.text: 阮感謝恁的鼓勵甲支持　請恁著愛保重自己
blocks.spelling: gún kám-siā lí ê kóo-lē kā tsi-tshî tshiánn lí tio̍h-ài pó-tiōng ka-kī

blocks.text: 不通擱為阮來掛意　請恁相信　我要乎恁一片天
blocks.spelling: m̄-thang koh uî gún lâi kuà-ì tshiánn lín siong-sìn guá beh hōo lí tsi̍t phìnn thinn

blocks.text: 親愛的爸爸媽媽　只要恁平安快樂過日子
blocks.spelling: tshin-ài ē pā-pā-má-má tsí-iàu lí pîng-an khuài-lo̍k kuè li̍t-tsí

blocks.text: 不需要擱計較什麼　再大的風雨攏會過去
blocks.spelling: bô-su-iàu koh kè-kàu siánn-mih tsài tuā ê hong-hōo lóng ē kuè-khì

blocks.text: 返來恁身邊看你　有一日我一定會出頭天
blocks.spelling: tńg-lâi lín sin-pinn khuànn lí ū tsi̍t-li̍t guá it-tīng ē tshut-thâu-thinn

blocks.text: 倒返去甲恁來團圓　陪伴置恁身邊　袂來甲恁分開
blocks.spelling: tó tńg-khì kā lí lâi thuân-înn puê-phuānn tì lí sin-pinn buē lâi kā lín hun-khui

blocks.text: 返來恁身邊
blocks.spelling: tńg-lâi lín sin-pinn
